info.title: API.SH: ALDI
info.description: The ALDI API from API.SH: public ALDI data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The collection tree the ALDI shop publishes for a store (ALDI exclusive brands and shop-by-diet collections), each with id, name, slug (use it in /aldi/v1/category), image and child collections. Department collections such as Milk, Eggs or Cheese are also accepted by /aldi/v1/category with the slug from their aldi.us link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/aldi-categories

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Store id from /aldi/v1/stores (e.g. 178404). Give store or zip.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: 5-digit US ZIP code. Without store, the nearest ALDI store to this ZIP is used; with fulfilment=delivery it is the delivery ZIP.

parameters.name: fulfilment
parameters.description: Price list: instore (shelf prices for shopping in the store, the default), pickup or delivery (the online prices, usually higher than in-store).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: ALDI products in a category with store prices
get.description:
The products in one ALDI shop collection (category) at one store, with that store's prices and stock, for in-store shopping (default), pickup or delivery. Collection slugs appear in aldi.us links (aldi.us/store/aldi/collections/<slug>, e.g. n-milk-33852 Milk, n-eggs-45223 Eggs, n-cheese-53839 Cheese) and in /aldi/v1/categories. Each product: id, name, brand, size, price (number) and its label, regular price, on-sale flag, sale label and disclaimer, promotions, unit price (per oz, lb...), pricing unit, sold by each or weight, per-order limit, availability and stock level at the store, category, tags, dietary tags, image, link, the store id, fulfilment, price type (in-store or online), fetched time, plus `raw` with the site's record. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/aldi-category

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Collection slug, e.g. n-milk-33852. Or pass url.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An aldi.us collection link (aldi.us/store/aldi/collections/<slug>).

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Store id from /aldi/v1/stores (e.g. 178404). Give store or zip.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: 5-digit US ZIP code. Without store, the nearest ALDI store to this ZIP is used; with fulfilment=delivery it is the delivery ZIP.

parameters.name: fulfilment
parameters.description: Price list: instore (shelf prices for shopping in the store, the default), pickup or delivery (the online prices, usually higher than in-store).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: best_match, price_asc or price_desc.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Filters from `facets[].values[].filter`, comma-separated, e.g. brand_id:16328,sales:on_sale.

parameters.name: on_sale
parameters.description: true: only products on sale at the store.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-based). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products per page (1-60).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: ALDI product search with store prices
get.description:
Search ALDI's products at one store with that store's prices and stock: in-store shelf prices (default) or the online pickup/delivery prices. Prices differ by store and by shopping method. Results come in the site's order: direct matches first (`match`: result), then the related items the site adds (`match`: related); `results` counts the direct matches. Each product: id, name, brand, size, price (number) and its label, regular price, on-sale flag, sale label and disclaimer, promotions, unit price (per oz, lb...), pricing unit, sold by each or weight, per-order limit, availability and stock level at the store, category, tags, dietary tags, image, link, the store id, fulfilment, price type (in-store or online), fetched time, plus `raw` with the site's record. The response also has the store, the facets the site offers for the query (brands, package type, dietary, on sale...) with their filter values, the applied filters, total and the fetch time.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/aldi-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search keywords, e.g. milk.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Store id from /aldi/v1/stores (e.g. 178404). Give store or zip.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: 5-digit US ZIP code. Without store, the nearest ALDI store to this ZIP is used; with fulfilment=delivery it is the delivery ZIP.

parameters.name: fulfilment
parameters.description: Price list: instore (shelf prices for shopping in the store, the default), pickup or delivery (the online prices, usually higher than in-store).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: best_match, price_asc or price_desc.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Filters from `facets[].values[].filter`, comma-separated, e.g. brand_id:16328,sales:on_sale.

parameters.name: on_sale
parameters.description: true: only products on sale at the store.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-based). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products per page (1-60).

get.summary: ALDI stores near a ZIP code
get.description:
ALDI stores near a US ZIP code, nearest first, as the shop's store chooser lists them: for in-store shopping (default) or pickup. Each store: id (use it as `store` in the other ALDI endpoints), name, street address, city, state, ZIP, latitude, longitude, distance in miles and its label, phone when shown, pickup notes, plus `raw`. A ZIP code the site does not know answers 400; a ZIP with no store nearby returns an empty list.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/aldi-stores

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: 5-digit US ZIP code.

parameters.name: fulfilment
parameters.description: instore (stores for in-store shopping, default) or pickup (stores offering pickup).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Most stores to return (1-100).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

stores.name: ALDI - BAT 42 - 451 N Randall Rd. Batavia, IL 60510

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
